types.name: Raw and central moments
types.description: Gives moments about some value (or about zero) and asks for the mean, variance or a central moment, or asks a property such as μ₁ = 0.

types.name: Karl Pearson's skewness
types.description: Gives mean, mode or median and SD and asks for Karl Pearson's coefficient of skewness, or works backwards from it.

types.name: Bowley's quartile skewness
types.description: Gives Q₁, median and Q₃ (or percentiles) and asks for Bowley's or Kelly's coefficient of skewness.

types.name: Moment skewness β₁ and γ₁
types.description: Gives μ₂ and μ₃ and asks for β₁, γ₁ or the direction of skewness.

types.name: Kurtosis β₂ and γ₂
types.description: Gives μ₂ and μ₄ (or β₂) and asks for β₂, γ₂ or whether the curve is lepto-, meso- or platykurtic.

types.name: Shape from mean, median and mode
types.description: Asks the direction of skewness from the order of mean, median and mode, from the tail, or from quartile gaps, without a full calculation.
